entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A villainous otaku has been[n]defiling the holy land.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Akihabara, duh. Try to keep up.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yes. Reports say this blackguard[n]haunts Akihabara.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you know who the target is?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: He's a jerk, is what he is. He cuts[n]in line, he hoards limited-edition[n]merch...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: He even beats up passersby and[n]damages the cool stuff they've[n]just bought.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You don't got his real name?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There've been reports from the[n]victims, but not much on the guy[n]himself.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Can I ask all of you to[n]get some more intel?
